detector.name: Corn metrics
detector.programText:
A = data('corn.test').publish(label='A')
B = data('demo.lb.hosts').scale(10).publish(label='B')
C = data('demo.trans.count', filter=filter('demo_datacenter', 'Tokyo') and (not filter('demo_host', 'server6', 'server4'))).scale(0.1).publish(label='C')
detect((when(A > threshold(C))) or (when(C > threshold(6)))).publish('Corn metrics')
